arabic text: MAWLA HAQ IMAM YA HASSAN YA HUSSAIN, YA HUSSAIN, YA HUSSAIN
english translation text: OH THE MASTER OF TRUTH, YA HASSAN YA HUSSAIN, YA HUSSAIN, YA HUSSAIN

arabic text:
WOH ABID-E-BEEMAR THA
CHALNAY SE JO, LAACHAAR THA
AUR SHAAM KA BAZAAR THA...
AUR MUSTAFA KI BETIYAA..
english translation text:
THE UNWELL SLAVE
THE ONE UNABLE TO WALK
HE WAS IN THE MARKETPLACE OF SHAAM
WITH THE DAUGHTERS OF MUSTAFA

arabic text:
SHABBIR KI WOH LAADLI,
SEENAY PE JO, SHAH KE PALI
JIS KI ABAA, BANN MEIN JALI...
MU PAR TAMAACHON KE NISHAAN...
english translation text:
SHABBIR’S BELOVED DAUGHTER.
NURTURED ON HIS CHEST.
WHOSE HIJAAB WAS BURNT
ON HER FACE WAS THE BRUISES OF THE SLAPS

arabic text:
WOH ASGHAR-E-BESHEER THA
AUR HURMALA KA TEER THA
LARZI ZAMEEN AUR AASMAAN
PYAASA GALA, KYU KAR KATAA...
english translation text:
ASGHER THE HUNGRY ONE
AND THE ARROW HEAD OF HURMALA
WHY DID THE THIRSTY NECK SEVER?
THAT SHOOK THE HEAVENS AND THE EARTH.

arabic text:
CHAADAR CHINI DURRE LAGAY
ABBAS KE PARCHAM TALAY...
RO KAR KAHEN, YEH BIBIYAN..
PYASE GALE, KHANJAR CHALE
english translation text:
THIRSTY THROAT, STRUCK WITH DAGGERS.
VEIL SNATCHED, AND SMOTED
UNDER THE FLAG OF ABBAS
THE LADIES CRIED OUT.

arabic text:
RO KAR KAHE QASIM KI MAA
MAARA GAYA, QASIM JAWAAN
AYE LAAL MEIN, DHUNDOON KAHAAN...
MEHNDI TERI, SEHRA TERA...
english translation text:
QASIMS MOTHER CRIES OUT
THE YOUTHFUL QASIM IS NO MORE
WHERE SHALL I SEEK MY SON
YOUR WEDDING RITUALS

arabic text:
SHAAM-E-GARIBAA CHAA GAYI,
ABID KO GAIRAT KHA GAYI
PEHRE PE ZAINAB AA GAYI....
ABBAS AUR, AKBAR KAHAAN....
english translation text:
THE EVE OF DESTITUTE HAS ARRIVED
ABID DIGNITY WAS HURT
AS ZAINAB TOOK GUARD
WHERE IS ABBAS AND AKBAR

arabic text:
WOH BAWAFA, ABBAS THA
DUKHIYON KI JO, EK AAS TAH
PAANI MILA, PAR NA PIYAA...
PYAASI RAHI, SHEHZADIYAN...
english translation text:
ABBAS WAS THE LOYAL ONE
THE ONE HOPE OF THE BEREAVED
FOUND WATER BUT DIDN’T DRINK
WHEN THE WOMEN WERE THIRSTY
